items.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
items.description: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.

items.title: Yemeni forces retreat to defend port city from Houthis
items.description: Saudi-backed forces say they are moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to protect the interim capital, Aden.

items.title: Trump backs return of  ex-Nvidia boss after 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign
items.description: A number of tech figures want the board of the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.

items.title: Man sentenced over 'horrific' attempted murder of three children
items.description: Riad Bouchaker was sentenced after the attempted murder of three children in November 2023.

items.title: Raye, Rosalia and Dolly Parton recognised in Grammy nominations
items.description: British singer Raye lands 11 nominations while Dolly Parton is recognised two months after her death.

items.title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
items.description: Russia said Ukraine had launched over 2,000 drones over the course of a day, while Kyiv came under a record 17 air raid alerts.

items.title: UK and allies call on Israel to allow rapid humanitarian access to Gaza
items.description: The UK, Australia, Canada and Italy say Israeli authorities are holding back vital supplies at the borders, including 150,00 tents.

items.title: Gérard Depardieu drops appeal against sexual assault conviction
items.description: The French film star was due to start an appeal trial after being found guilty of sexually assaulting two women on a Paris set.

items.title: Estonia to close Russia border crossings after attempted drone factory arson attack
items.description: The Estonian government says Russia was behind the attempted sabotage, which the Kremlin denies.

items.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 17 dead
items.description: The shootings in KwaZulu-Natal and Gauteng highlight South Africa's struggle to curb violent crime.

items.title: Australian MP 'full of gratitude' upon leaving hospital after alleged car attack
items.description: The MP lost both of her legs after the alleged attack outside her electorate office four weeks ago.

items.title: Mexican drug lord Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo dies age 80
items.description: Known as the 'Boss of Bosses', he was the head of all-powerful Guadalajara Cartel in the 1980s before his arrest broke up his drug organisation.
